Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
For 2012, someone must track the qualifier tournament results.

This can be done simply, with a single thread on this forum.

See the list for 2011, here:
www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/10-news-and-announcements/6144

as an example.

I do not intend to provide this service, someone from V:EKN must take this action if the V:EKN means to allow players that have not won tournaments to qualify for future continental championship events.

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
I'll do that.
I posted my "volunteer application" for this in here.
I've just checked and it was in the NC sub-forum. Sorry.

To the point: nobody said anything against and some people hit the Thank You button, so I guess it is ok.

I haven't done anything about it because it is not very relevant at the moment and I was waiting for the results of the First Chance Qualifier in Poland to start building a list with the other First Chance Qualifiers and smaller Tournaments.
Most likely it will be a Sticky Post on a sub-forum here at VEKN.
I'll work the details with the Admins.

BTW, if people have other ideas about this, I welcome the feedback.

Tiago Brum,
NC Portugal
